name: Timeline
purpose: Ordered chronological event presentation using native list and time semantics.

guidance.useWhen: Use for read-only chronological histories where event order and timestamps are meaningful and entry content remains application-owned.
guidance.avoidWhen: Avoid for interactive feeds, application notification state, or unordered status collections; keep persistence and activity schemas in the consuming application.
guidance.aiUsageNotes: Treat Timeline as a state-free semantic ordered-list wrapper. Entry data, actors, actions, persistence, loading, and filtering remain application-owned; use the Activity Log pattern for actor/action/time histories.

accessibility: Preserve ordered-list semantics and source order; each entry must remain a native list item and timestamps should use readable text with a machine-readable time value when available.
owns one native ordered-list container so chronological order remains explicit browser list semantics
projected timeline entries must become native list items and preserve source order without visual reordering that changes chronological meaning
timestamps must have understandable visible text and should use native time semantics with a machine-readable datetime value when available
the component is read-only presentation and must not introduce feed, listbox, grid, selection, or live-region semantics unless a separate interactive contract requires them
knownLimitations: Read-only presentation only; persistence, loading, filtering, actor/action schemas, selection, and live-feed behavior remain application-owned.
